scope: Negotiated laptop-demo ActorEngine only; baseline HumDial, legacy and TACT remain unchanged
original_interrupt: Inherited verbatim from src/config.yaml as the flag-off baseline. The guarded path uses a separate typed input_route, not a rewritten binary prompt or binary AND veto.
mechanisms: Strict keep/stop_only/yield_wait/yield_ready admission with one repair and a shared 2-second timeout; safe fallback is keep
Independent raw input ID/revision and accepted epoch; no raw VAD cancellation of already-playing audio
Stop-only and explicit waiting never arm the old 2.5-second forced response; long VAD triggers classification, not a blind stop
VAD-END audio snapshot, private response and first-sentence TTS, hold-gated publication, real SSE cancellation and request capacity accounting
Synchronized mic/render-reference PCM16 upload, exact packet validation, bounded delayed waveform fit and original-band residual check
Preplay-only hold/release with retained PCM; typed acceptance cancels obsolete candidates and merges continued input
Playback EOF preserves input identity; reset cancels all input tasks and invalidates late stop acknowledgements
Partial-node playback-stopped acknowledgement and sentence-boundary interrupted-history prefix

browser_normal_turns.notes: Virtual 48k microphone through the real two-input worklet; not physical listening. Response factual quality is not certified. This preceded the additional original-band residual protection.

deployment_interactions.acoustic_setup: Digital 96ms delayed, gain-0.35 render-reference echo injection; actual browser playback and Omni/VAD/engine, not a physical room

failures_preserved.cause: Original-binary AND gate rejected a clear request; guarded route alone was correct. Removed the redundant veto, preserved original baseline.

Trailing assistant-reference colon with an empty reference misattributed microphone audio; same unchanged question gave keep before explicit metadata/audio separation and yield_ready after. Production/warmup/canary now share route_messages.

Startup ASR readback mismatch for a bilingual greeting; service correctly refused readiness. Warmup now allows one logged retry without relaxing the equality check. Final deployment passed on first attempts.

EOF cleanup initially left a finished-output pipeline waiting for credit; deterministic cleanup test caught the orphan and the actor now cancels/retires it without marking completed playback cancelled.
Reset originally cleared guard records before cancellation could recreate them; reordered cleanup and added stale-stop-ACK regression.

deployment.restart_notes: Validated owned launcher targets; listener/GPU empty before each full start. Final extra restart loaded the original-band residual enhancement.

limitations: No physical laptop microphone/speaker or real-room echo acceptance; no speaker verification or general AEC guarantee
Semantic admission remains model-dependent; false rejection/false interruption is still possible
Waveform thresholds are conservative uncalibrated engineering defaults; nonlinear/long-delay echo may not match
History uses completed sentence boundaries and WebAudio acknowledgement, not word-aligned or physically heard prefixes
Additional routing and speculative work consume capacity; smoke timings are not formal benchmark scores
No file/source/artifact integrity hashes computed or checked; private user sessions and unrelated user edits excluded from publication
